messages:
maria: FYI paging — APAC embeddings service (emb-v2) started returning 5xx at ~10:12 UTC. Error rate ~18% and rising, latency spikes for successful requests. Rolling error spikes correlate with a model rollout from earlier today.

incident-bot: @channel incident created: INC-2026-0421 (embeddings degradation - APAC). Severity: P2. Pager notified: tim.

tim: I’m on it. Can someone paste the best short customer-facing impact line? I’ll start an initial statuspage draft and take handoff.

maria: short: "Some customers in APAC may experience failed or delayed embedding requests while we investigate." More detail: "Errors are isolated to emb-v2 instances in ap-southeast-1 after a recent model rollout; emb-v1 endpoints are still healthy and configured as automatic fallback for most traffic."

sam: copying ops checklist — let's avoid naming impl details publicly. Status page should have: start time, affected region, user impact, mitigation steps, and next update ETA.

anna: support note: show-templates for customers — if they ask: give them the public status link and advise retrying in 30s or using the emb-v1 model via model param. I’ll prepare a canned reply.

maria: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable traffic routing to emb-v1 in ap-southeast-1 (manual route). 2) rollback model variant on a single node pool to confirm. 3) scale up warm emb-v1 replicas if request surge expected.

tim: doing route change now. Running command: ```./infractl route set --region ap-southeast-1 --model-id emb-v1 --weight 100 --dry-run=false```

incident-bot: action: traffic routing updated by tim at 10:25 UTC — all ap-southeast-1 incoming weighting set to emb-v1 fallbacks. Monitor: 5m.

sam: checklist item: draft initial status update below. Please review quickly then I’ll publish (tim to confirm publication):

```
Initial status (10:28 UTC)
- Impact: Users in APAC may experience failed or delayed embedding requests.
- Scope: Errors originating from emb-v2 instances in ap-southeast-1. Other regions and emb-v1 remain healthy.
- Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to emb-v1 in APAC to reduce errors; engineers are rolling back a recent model variant and monitoring error rates.
- Next update: 10:40 UTC or earlier as new info becomes available.
```

jay: small wording tweak: change "Users" -> "Some API requests" (less absolute). Also add "We will follow up when full service is restored."

maria: agree. Revised single-line impact for status page: "Some API requests in APAC may experience failures or higher latency when calling embeddings (emb-v2)."

tim: publishing 1st update now to status page draft. Using console: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/draft/incident-1912345678 (publishing as "Investigating").

incident-bot: @maria @tim statuspage update published (Investigating) at 10:33 UTC. Public URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1912345678 — customers will see the initial message.

anna: posted canned support reply in #support-ops and queued an email template for affected customers. Template excerpt: "We are investigating intermittent failures for embedding requests in APAC. We recommend retrying or switching to emb-v1 for lower error rates."

sam: Ops note for internal timeline: document rollback attempt at 10:36; verification window 10:36–10:45. Keep periodic updates every ~15 mins or on material change.

maria: rollback initiated on a canary node pool. Commands/log snippet: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/emb-v2-canary -n embeddings --to-revision=42``` System logs show model load errors around 10:11.

tim: after routing to emb-v1 and rollback start, error rate dropped to ~4% at 10:42. Still seeing occasional 502 spikes. Monitoring closely.

sam: drafting second status update. Please review:

```
Update 10:45 UTC
- What we changed: Traffic routing to emb-v1 in ap-southeast-1 to reduce failed requests. Canary rollback for emb-v2 in progress.
- Current state: Error rate reduced, but some 502 spikes persist in short bursts. We are continuing verification and will update within 30 minutes.
- Customer action: No action required; retries should succeed. If you rely on emb-v2 specifically, reach out to support for targeted guidance.
```

jay: add "We will keep emb-v1 as the active route until we confirm stability" — makes expectations clear.

sam: included. Publishing update 10:47.

incident-bot: statuspage update published (Identified -> Mitigated steps applied) at 10:47 UTC.

maria: monitoring graphs — request volume stable, error rate hovering 1–3% now. Load test not reproducing. I want to keep emb-v1 route for at least 2 hours and then try controlled canary of emb-v2 when risk is low.

anna: support queued follow-up to customers who reported incidents; tagging for more details.

tim: scheduling on-call handoff note for next shift: "Keep emb-v1 routing in APAC, watch error rate and CPU on emb-v1 replicas, do not reintroduce emb-v2 until SRE lead signs off." Leaving a pinned message in #incidents.

sam: drafting resolved notice for once metrics stable for 60m. Draft below for review: 

```
Resolved (12:10 UTC)
- Summary: We rolled back a recent emb-v2 model variant and routed APAC traffic to emb-v1. Error rate returned to normal levels and user-facing failures have stopped.
- Impact: Some API requests in APAC experienced failures and increased latency between 10:12–12:00 UTC.
- Root cause: An issue with the emb-v2 model variant + model load timing under regional load (investigation ongoing).
- Actions: emb-v1 remains primary in APAC while we run a full postmortem and validate a safe emb-v2 rollout.
- Contact: support@redwood.ai for ongoing customer help.
```

jay: looks good. Add a line: "We will publish a post-incident report within 72 hours."

maria: published resolved update at 12:11 UTC. incident-bot: please create postmortem ticket and assign to eng-ml + eng-sre with high priority.

incident-bot: created ticket PM-191234 for post-incident review and assigned to eng-ml, eng-sre.

tim: posting final note to thread and closing pager. Great coordination — thanks everyone. :tada:

anna: sent follow-up emails to affected customers with link to resolved status and support contact.

maria: closing notes: save all logs to incident folder and attach to postmortem. I’ll start the timeline doc.

sam: marking this thread as ready for incident review. If anyone needs the exact published copy, link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1912345678

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0421 closed at 12:13 UTC.

tim: closing handoff — leaving a short checklist in the incident ticket for oncall-next: monitor emb-v1 CPU, confirm 60m of stable errors <0.5%, and coordinate PM for rollback plan.

maria: thanks team.
